title: gentiana alsinoides subsp. scabrifilamenta
intro: Gentiana alsinoides subsp. scabrifilamenta, commonly known as Chinese Gentian, is a plant species that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Gentian include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems, making it a valuable remedy in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of Gentiana alsinoides subsp. scabrifilamenta include gentiopicrin, gentianine, and other iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
